scope: Unmodified downloaded signed Mac application with isolated data/profile and synthetic history/memory; no live credentials, tool execution or long-term acceptance.
checks: 52px header with SVG Bot settings entry opens Settings directly
Published Bot settings saves a generated-avatar identity color using the real local profile
Overview and saved Memory remain readable in right sidebar
Chat uses named Bot composer and contained synthetic assistant replies; real-turn details/streaming are covered by source packet, not this seed
Signed application renders saved avatar identity tint in actual assistant bubbles
Published RC11 updater checks real Beta feed with no downgrade offered

screenshots.name: signed-bot-settings.png
screenshots.observation: 实际签名RC11包：52px紧凑页头、SVG机器人设置入口、右侧设置标签选中，模型选择因隔离夹具未配置模型而禁用；中央紫色身份气泡完整。设置卡片在自己的滚动容器内继续向下，没有遮挡输入框。

screenshots.name: signed-bot-overview.png
screenshots.observation: 真实保存头像颜色后，列表、页头与中央气泡同步为珊瑚色；右侧概况名称/绑定目录/任务概览可读，浅色边界清晰，输入框保留。

screenshots.name: signed-bot-memory.png
screenshots.observation: 右侧记忆显示三条夹具内容与筛选、操作及分页；记忆卡片不侵入主对话，身份色气泡和机器人名称仍一致。

screenshots.name: signed-chat.png
screenshots.observation: 关闭右侧栏后返回主对话，消息与输入框同一左侧网格；头像珊瑚色和柔和气泡一致，用户消息保持右对齐；左下角RC11标识可见，未见溢出或遮挡。

limits: Synthetic history/memory and isolated configuration; no live credentials or model turn.
Four actual signed Mac application screenshots were visually inspected; does not cover interactive Windows/Linux installation, full screen-reader or long-term use.
Real current-version Beta updater check is covered by script receipt, not inferred from static screenshot.
